name: place-pages
title: Place pages
description: A wiki page for every café, restaurant, bar, lounge, hotel, shop, museum or park you spend time at: every visit, who came, and every photo you took there, linked from one photo library so a photo is never stored twice. Questions and messages about a place can then show it. Homes, offices, doctors and transit never get a page. It runs every morning over the past week, so your corrections to a day move its photos with them.
